text:
marie (product): heads up 1 acme asked for tenant-level routing + a billing hook to do internal chargebacks. competitor rolling this out and sales wants parity. thoughts? :eyes:

ben (sales): renewal in 6w. they want predictable latency per-tenant, ability to route to cheaper models under load, and a single metering webhook.

alex (eng): we have primitives in Dedicated but not productized. exposing APIs + metering + RBAC is doable. ballpark 6-8w for minimal product with tests.

ryan (eng-runtime): engineering risks: cache invalidation across model variants, cross-tenant KV safety, and continuity of eval metrics when fallback occurs. need a canonical fallback semantics doc.

anya (design): if we go minimal I can deliver a 1-page admin mock + docs in 3 business days for PS usage.

sam (growth): we should avoid a pure parity framing. position as "flex routing for predictable economics" and ship with cost controls narrative.

marie (product): options: (A) fast parity: API + metering, PS setup, 6w; (B) full product: add self-serve UI + templates, 8w; (C) invest in a differentiated cost-sla policy, 4w but riskier.

ben (sales): acme will accept PS short-term if we commit to a roadmap date. prefer full but ok with minimal with written commitment.

alex (eng): scope freeze for fast parity: no UI, default fallback policy, metering events, RBAC hooks. commit A+B in 6w. caveat: expect a small hotfix after canary.

marie (product): launch criteria for fast parity: - API + docs published - canary with acme for 2w - metering webhook verified - fallback policy in place. If met, commit to self-serve UI next sprint.

ryan (eng-runtime): add regression criteria: no KV cache correctness regressions, p95 latency impact <10%, and e2e fallback smoke tests passing in canary.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: routing-api v0.1 -> staging at 3165012000.

marie (product): decision: go with option A (fast parity) and lead with cost-control messaging. action owners: @alex eng plan, @ryan canary plan, @anya docs+mock, @ben customer comms. reconvene after canary week. :pray:
